required_arrays.molecule_id: one-dimensional unicode strings; unique and aligned to all arrays
required_arrays.protein: float32 [n, protein_dim], real cached protein encoder features
required_arrays.chemical: float32 [n, chemical_dim], real cached complete-molecule encoder features
required_arrays.edit: float32 [n, edit_dim], explicitly defined chemical-edit/context features

optional_arrays.geometry: float32 [n, geometry_dim]; real geometry encoding for these molecules

notes: This file defines an input contract, not pretrained embeddings.
Do not silently map noncanonical residues to canonical residues as the sole chemical representation.
Preserve chirality, cyclization connectivity, and terminal chemistry in the molecular identity.
A reference used to define an edit must have a recorded parent_molecule_id.
Future pair experiments must keep parent/analogue families inside a single split.
